1.1.1 What Python Is Explanation Python is a general purpose high level programming language. Two independent claims: General purpose — Python is not tied to one problem domain. The same language is used for scripting, web backends, automation, data analysis, machine learning, testing, GUIs and glue code. Contrast with domain-specific languages: SQL only queries data, HTML only describes documents, MATLAB targets num

1.1.2 Dynamically Typed Language Explanation Dynamically typed language: given a value, type will be assigned automatically. You never declare a type. You bind a name to a value, and the type belongs to the value (the object), not to the name . The name is only a label pointing at an object; rebinding it to a different kind of object is legal.
